dct_description_sm: Several hundred thousands migratory tundra caribou are distributed in Northern Qubec and Labrador, ranging over nearly a million square kilometres. Two populations of migratory caribou are recognized, the Rivire-aux-Feuilles herd is very large and declining; the Rivire-George herd has decreased 98% over the last two decades. The factors influencing changes in body condition of migratory caribou are still poorly understood, but are essential to our understanding of natural and human-induced variations in the survival and reproductive success of individuals and the demography of herds. The aim of this study if to monitor the body condition of caribou in Rivire-aux-Feuilles and Rivire-George herds.

dct_title_s: Monitoring of the body condition of migratory caribou in Rivire-aux-Feuilles and Rivire-George herds in Nunavik and Labrador
